Body.Content:
Project Operations calculates cost and sales estimates for resource assignments, including daily, time-phased estimates. These calculations can repeatedly use the same role-pricing information across assignments and dates.

With this feature enabled, Project Operations caches and reuses applicable role prices, markups, and price overrides within each estimate-pricing operation. This reduces repeated pricing lookups, helping improve responsiveness when calculating or updating estimates, particularly for larger projects.

The cache is scoped to the pricing operation and is recreated for subsequent operations. The feature is intended to improve performance without changing pricing rules or calculated results.

GA date: November CY2026
